versions.changelog:
Initial release of court-practice skill — access and analyze Russian court practice via reputation.ru.

- Provides unified access to arbitration, general jurisdiction, and Supreme Court case data and analytics.
- Supports fast case searching, full text retrieval, and synthesized deep analysis reports.
- Requires a reputation.ru API key (REPUTATION_API_KEY) — paid third-party service.
- Detailed setup instructions for both MCP (account sign-in or API key) and direct REST API usage.
- Clear routing and usage guidance for all supported court systems.
